goal: An accepted project must never silently disappear because a chat turn, context, model quota, tunnel request or UI stream ends. Effects remain at-most-once; completion/blocker state is durable; a bounded final result is eventually discoverable/deliverable without re-running work.
outageNote: Power outage occurred 2026-09-26 during local implementation. Local working tree contains uncommitted CSDC code and must be inspected/reconciled after power returns before any cloud branch is merged.

tasks.title: Durable delivery store
tasks.scope: Persist completion/delivery records independently of chat context.
tasks.acceptance: A completed job survives process/chat restart with delivery state and immutable result hash.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Durable SQLite delivery core persists records across reopen/restart and keeps state private from project roots; delivery-store regression suite is included in full CI.

tasks.title: Correlation identity
tasks.scope: Carry one correlationId across request, workflow/run, operation, artifact and delivery.
tasks.acceptance: A support trace can map one accepted request end-to-end without heuristic log matching.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Opaque correlationId is persisted through detached operations and Project Engine runs into delivery artifacts/events.
notes: End-to-end Chat request/tunnel request correlation is not yet proven; CSDC-030 remains outstanding.

tasks.title: Delivery state machine
tasks.scope: Implement COMPLETED_UNDELIVERED -> DELIVERY_PENDING -> DELIVERED/DEAD_LETTER.
tasks.acceptance: Transitions are durable, idempotent and covered by restart/lost-ack tests.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Delivery transitions COMPLETED_UNDELIVERED -> DELIVERY_PENDING -> DELIVERED and bounded DEAD_LETTER semantics are durable/idempotent in delivery-store tests.

tasks.title: Pending-delivery inbox
tasks.scope: Expose bounded read/claim/ack paths for undelivered results.
tasks.acceptance: A later chat can discover and claim an earlier completed result without re-running effects.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Bounded MCP delivery_status/list/get/claim/ack/read_artifact surface is integrated; correlation mismatch fails closed; artifacts are chunked.

tasks.title: Chat completion bridge
tasks.scope: Use a supported host mechanism to wake/resume delivery when available; retain polling fallback.
tasks.acceptance: Real ChatGPT qualification proves autonomous delivery, or capability is marked external/unavailable with safe fallback.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Commander-side durable inbox fallback is implemented and cross-platform CI passes.
notes: Autonomous ChatGPT wake/push cannot be claimed unless the host advertises the MCP Tasks/subscriptions capability on the actual request. Native host capability still requires live observation.

tasks.title: WAITING/BLOCKED delivery
tasks.scope: Create durable user-visible events for WAITING_INPUT, BLOCKED, EXHAUSTED and quota pauses.
tasks.acceptance: No terminal/wait state can become silent.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
WAITING_INPUT and BLOCKED project states are regression-tested as durable correlation-scoped delivery events; code also maps COMPLETED/EXHAUSTED/CANCELLED/PAUSED.
notes: Need explicit executable coverage for every mapped terminal/wait state before PASS.

tasks.title: Lost-ack idempotency for mutations
tasks.scope: Add stable idempotency to mutating file/process/terminal/browser/GUI operations.
tasks.acceptance: Lost response never causes a blind duplicate effect.

tasks.title: Universal deferred execution
tasks.scope: Extend deferred/durable work beyond run_shell/run_project_command to all potentially slow tools.
tasks.acceptance: Any uncertain-duration tool can return a small durable handle before transport deadline.

tasks.title: Transport safety budget
tasks.scope: Reserve explicit margin below tunnel response deadline for every synchronous call.
tasks.acceptance: No Commander synchronous call can consume the full tunnel deadline.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36224867884 PASS on Windows and Ubuntu at fd8bec724c17b9ed04de42db36ff509f46cc8bdf.
Synchronous command safety budget was reduced to reserve transport headroom; long/unknown work remains directed to detached operation_start.
notes: Live tunnel canary after rollout is still required by CSDC-035/release qualification; this PASS is for the Commander-side safety-budget requirement.

tasks.title: Turn-safe orchestration
tasks.scope: Prevent long chains of MCP calls from keeping one chat turn alive until failure.
tasks.acceptance: Large projects acknowledge quickly and continue from durable state rather than a single long turn.
evidence: fd8bec transport headroom PASS; durable detached operation + delivery inbox path PASS in cross-platform CI.
notes: Potentially slow non-command tools are not universally deferred yet; CSDC-008 remains open.

tasks.title: Result envelope
tasks.scope: Separate compact chat summary from full artifact/output.
tasks.acceptance: Final chat payload stays bounded while complete evidence remains retrievable.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Full operation/project result payloads are stored as content-addressed bounded artifacts; delivery metadata remains compact; artifact reads are capped/chunked.

tasks.title: Exactly-once delivery receipt
tasks.scope: Persist delivery attempt/ack identities and suppress duplicate final answers.
tasks.acceptance: Retrying delivery cannot re-execute work or duplicate an acknowledged result.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Same delivery attempt claim/ack is idempotent; duplicate event key returns same delivery; changed payload conflicts fail closed.

tasks.title: Native MCP Tasks capability probe
tasks.scope: Probe ChatGPT Plugin support for MCP Tasks/subscriptions and implement only when negotiated.
tasks.acceptance: Capability is runtime-proven; no speculative protocol claim.

tasks.title: Paged/ranged reads
tasks.scope: Add paging/range contracts for large text/binary/list/search results.
tasks.acceptance: Files/results larger than one MCP envelope remain retrievable without 413.

tasks.title: Request/response size alignment
tasks.scope: Align tool schemas with request/response envelopes or move content to artifacts.
tasks.acceptance: No advertised payload size is impossible to transport.

tasks.title: Project Engine execution primitive
tasks.scope: Permit safe background build/run/test via a durable bounded execution primitive.
tasks.acceptance: Enrolled execution projects can perform verified command work without unrestricted planner shell.

tasks.title: Long-project decomposition
tasks.scope: Split projects into durable milestone/subrun units beyond the default five-minute run window.
tasks.acceptance: Hour-scale projects progress through checkpoints instead of EXHAUSTED due solely to wall time.

tasks.title: Pause human-wait clock
tasks.scope: Do not consume execution wall-clock while legitimately waiting for user input.
tasks.acceptance: WAITING_INPUT does not expire before the user can answer.

tasks.title: Quota/rate-limit state
tasks.scope: Classify provider quota/rate-limit as durable PAUSED_QUOTA with safe resume.
tasks.acceptance: Quota exhaustion never becomes an ambiguous failure or duplicate execution.

tasks.title: Context retrieval/compaction
tasks.scope: Keep working context bounded using durable refs/indexes rather than raw transcript growth.
tasks.acceptance: Large projects do not fail solely because history grew.

tasks.title: Workflow rollover/archive
tasks.scope: Compact/archive state before workflow/event/note/count limits are reached.
tasks.acceptance: Long-lived projects remain writable and auditable.

tasks.title: External mutation detection
tasks.scope: Detect project-root changes made outside Commander locks before applying/replaying planned mutations.
tasks.acceptance: One-writer violations become explicit blockers rather than silent overwrite.

tasks.title: Process-tree lifecycle
tasks.scope: Guarantee timeout/cancel handles descendant processes and records durable outcome.
tasks.acceptance: No timed-out command leaves untracked children that can mutate later.

tasks.title: Transient filesystem/network-drive policy
tasks.scope: Classify and bounded-retry safe transient EPERM/EBUSY/network-share failures.
tasks.acceptance: Transient storage failures do not silently strand projects.

tasks.title: Browser/session escalation
tasks.scope: Persist browser-auth/CAPTCHA/MFA blockers and deliver a minimal foreground-approval request.
tasks.acceptance: Background jobs never silently hang on authentication.

tasks.title: Update-safe run migration
tasks.scope: Keep active workflow/run/delivery authority stable across auto-update and policy migrations.
tasks.acceptance: Updates do not strand or invalidate accepted jobs without explicit compatible migration.

tasks.title: Tunnel-client v0.0.15 qualification
tasks.scope: Candidate-test current upstream tunnel-client on Windows/Linux and pin if it passes.
tasks.acceptance: Exact binary/hash, regression and live canaries pass before promotion.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Source installers now pin OpenAI tunnel-client v0.0.15 and official release hashes/tag provenance were captured.
notes: Live Windows/Linux candidate qualification is still required before PASS.

tasks.title: Linux v0.9.3 completion
tasks.scope: Finish retained-terminal cutover and Firefox background browser, full qualification and release.
tasks.acceptance: Linux canonical connector reaches current release without killing active terminals.

tasks.title: Cross-device parity
tasks.scope: Make Windows/Linux capability and Project Engine behavior equivalent where platform permits.
tasks.acceptance: System-status parity matrix has no unexplained functional gaps.

tasks.title: End-to-end telemetry
tasks.scope: Record correlationId, transport request, tool, operation, workflow, result and delivery metrics.
tasks.acceptance: Deadline/post failures can be attributed to exact work instead of heuristic timestamps.

tasks.title: Durable alerting/dead-letter
tasks.scope: Surface COMPLETED_UNDELIVERED, blocked and dead-letter records in health/status.
tasks.acceptance: No failed delivery can remain invisible.

tasks.title: Acceptance-strength profiles
tasks.scope: Support domain-specific validators instead of treating weak text checks as correctness.
tasks.acceptance: COMPLETED means the configured technical/scientific acceptance really passed.

tasks.title: Fault-injection regression suite
tasks.scope: Test disconnects before ack, after effect, during planner, after completion and during delivery.
tasks.acceptance: Every injected cut preserves at-most-once effects and eventual discoverable result.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 36225716047: windows-latest PASS; ubuntu-latest PASS; head 6372bfa61bf265d7f337172c333f64b45072ba5d.
Restart/lost-ack/idempotent delivery, operation receipt backfill and correlation isolation tests are in full CI.
notes: Remaining fault matrix cases include real tunnel disconnect, power cuts, process-tree and long soak.

tasks.title: Multi-chat/account concurrency regression
tasks.scope: Test same project from concurrent chats/accounts with ownership/delivery isolation.
tasks.acceptance: No cross-chat result leakage, duplicate writer or duplicate effect.

tasks.title: Long soak qualification
tasks.scope: Run 24-48h real workload qualification after fixes.
tasks.acceptance: Zero Commander-caused deadline drops, silent terminal states and unrecoverable completed-undelivered jobs.

tasks.title: Release gate
tasks.scope: Block stable release unless chat-safe completion SLO passes on Windows and Linux.
tasks.acceptance: Release checklist requires evidence for all P0 items and accepted dispositions for remaining P1 items.
